tabs.html:
Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE-at 48V 0.65A Gigabit PoE+ Adapter

The Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE-at 48V 0.65A (30W) Gigabit PoE+ Adapter is a powerful and efficient solution designed to deliver both power and data to network devices through a single Ethernet cable. With an output of 48V DC at 0.65A, this adapter provides a total power output of 30W, making it ideal for high-performance devices such as wireless access points, IP cameras, and VoIP phones. This adapter features advanced surge protection, encompassing both difference and common mode protections, to safeguard connected equipment from potential voltage spikes. Clamping protection is set at 11V for data lines and 60V for power, ensuring optimal safety for sensitive electronics. Additionally, it boasts a maximum surge discharge capability of 1500A, providing robust defense in challenging environments. With an impressive efficiency rating of 87%, the U-POE-at minimizes energy loss, contributing to cost-effective operation. Its switching frequency of 70 kHz and an output ripple of only 1% ensure clean and stable power delivery. The device maintains excellent regulation performance, with line regulation at ≤ 3% and load regulation at ≤ 5%, ensuring consistent output under varying loads. Operating effectively in a temperature range of 0 to 40°C (32 to 104°F) and humidity levels of 10% to 95% non-condensing, the adapter is versatile enough for different environments. Its compact dimensions of 93 x 62 x 35 mm (3.66 x 2.44 x 1.38 inches) and lightweight design of 156 g (5.5 oz) make installation straightforward. Equipped with a gigabit LAN port and compliant with CE, FCC, IC, and UL certifications, the Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE-at is a reliable choice for enhancing your network infrastructure with efficient power delivery and robust protection. This adapter combines performance, safety, and ease of use, making it an essential addition to any networking setup.

Features of the Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE-at 48V 0.65A Gigabit PoE+ Adapter:

  • Power Output: Delivers 48V DC at 0.65A, providing up to 30W of power, suitable for high-performance devices.
  • Surge Protection: Features advanced surge protection, including both difference and common mode protection to safeguard connected equipment from voltage spikes.
  • Clamping Protection: Protects data lines at 11V and power at 60V, ensuring the safety of sensitive electronics.
  • High Efficiency: Achieves an efficiency rating of 87%, reducing energy waste during operation.
  • Compact Size: Dimensions of 93 x 62 x 35 mm (3.66 x 2.44 x 1.38 inches) and a weight of 156 g (5.5 oz) for easy installation in various setups.
  • Wide Operating Range: Operates efficiently in temperatures from 0 to 40°C (32 to 104°F) and humidity levels from 10% to 95% non-condensing.
  • Regulation Performance: Maintains line regulation of ≤ 3% and load regulation of ≤ 5%, ensuring stable power delivery under varying loads.
  • Fast Response Time: Features a response time of less than 1 nanosecond, allowing for quick adjustments to power demands.
  • Connectivity: Equipped with a gigabit LAN port for high-speed data transmission along with power delivery.
  • Robust Protection: Can handle a maximum surge discharge of 1500A, providing strong protection against electrical surges.
  • Multiple Certifications: Compliant with CE, FCC, IC, and UL certifications, ensuring reliable and safe operation.
